impacted.role: registers the Typer sub-apps (source.app at line 68); a context sub-app joins them
`source add` (line 81) accepts RSS URLs, reddit:// and youtube:// (and reddit.com / youtube.com URLs, lines 31-33), the forms the prompt's source lines must use
_validate_context_md (line 285) requires the High, Medium and Low Priority Topics sections
the evaluator prompt maps 'Not Interested' topics to no priority (line 120)
DEFAULT_CONTEXT_MD (line 90), the sample a first run writes, and the next-steps text (line 160)
Quick Start's hand-written context.md heredoc (line 67) and the Context Assistant section

constraints.text: The required sections are a local list inside _validate_context_md, so a test that checks the prompt against them needs them reachable as a named constant rather than a second copy.
Source type is inferred from the URL form, so a prompt that emits rss feed URLs, reddit://<sub> and youtube://<channel id or handle URL> produces commands `source add` accepts as written.
The first run writes a generic sample context with fixed interests; nothing personalizes it before the first fetch.
Principle V: the CLI's client-only install has no daemon package, so the bootstrap command must not import prismis_daemon.

issues.why: Multi-context profiles would need one bootstrap per profile; independent, own issue, and this prompt's single context.md is what it would generalize.

reuse.what: the required-section list, lifted to a module constant the test compares against
